# Mohit Ranka

> Engineering leader with 15+ years at Booking.com, Postman, LinkedIn and Moveworks. Open to full-time Engineering Lead and Engineering Manager roles.

Mohit Ranka is an engineering leader with 15+ years of hands-on engineering and engineering leadership at Booking.com, Postman, LinkedIn, and Moveworks. He works at the boundary between technical leadership and engineering management: close enough to the code to make sound technical calls, senior enough to own delivery and the decisions around it. He is open to full-time Engineering Lead and Engineering Manager roles.

Experience highlights:
- Booking.com: built authentication and authorization infrastructure for multiple portfolio products at roughly 1M requests per second
- Postman: led engineering around Runtime and core developer workflows for one of the world's most widely used API platforms
- LinkedIn: led enterprise data-platform work supporting major business functions and improving how quickly teams could access and act on data
- Forge: creator of the open-source terminal-native AI coding environment (https://github.com/NorviaLabs/forge)

Location and background: India; B.Tech. from Vellore Institute of Technology.

Primary contact: https://www.mohitranka.com/contact/ (web form)
Site: https://www.mohitranka.com
